metadata.title: Email Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating email as a trusted, identity-bearing, and accountable institutional communication channel.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Email infrastructure including mail transfer systems, routing services, mailboxes, gateways, and client access mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing baseline trust assumptions and centralized enforcement for institutional email systems.

props.name: data-object
props.remarks: Email messages as managed institutional information objects subject to protection, audit, and records requirements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for trustworthy email principles including sender authentication, policy enforcement, and monitoring expectations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for foundational email transport, routing, and gateway security principles.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced to establish institutional email as a critical enabling service whose disruption or misconfiguration may cause cascading organizational impact.

metadata.remarks: Email Core defines the foundational trust properties required to operate email as a reliable institutional communication channel. It establishes baseline assumptions for authenticated delivery, centralized enforcement, and accountability.

components.title: Email Identity Binding
components.description: Binds email messages to authenticated and accountable sender identities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Phishing attempts relying on unauthenticated or spoofed email identities.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Authentication and cryptographic verification of email sender identity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email access and submission are tied to authenticated user or service identities.
Credential management supports accountable use of email identities.
Cryptographic mechanisms bind identity assertions to email messages.
Email accounts are provisioned and managed to maintain accurate identity association.

components.title: Email Delivery Assurance
components.description: Ensures email messages are routed, transmitted, and delivered without unauthorized modification.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of email transport as a command-and-control channel.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Policy-enforced routing and delivery of institutional email.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection mechanisms constrain exposure of institutional email services.
Transmission confidentiality and integrity protect email in transit.
Email routing mechanisms prevent unauthorized redirection or alteration.

components.title: Email Accountability
components.description: Provides auditability and traceability of email usage and message handling.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized access to or collection of email content following compromise.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Logging and review of email activity to support investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email-related events are defined and captured for audit purposes.
Audit review supports investigation and accountability for email activity.
Email audit records are generated for significant security-relevant events.
